title: Reference approach: Tensor Calculator
answer: Implement tensor calculator in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: torch.tensor, torch.mean, torch.sum. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 019. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
a = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.]); b = torch.tensor([3., 2., 1.])
print((a+b).tolist(), (a*b).tolist(), a.mean().item(), (a < b).tolist())
reference_code:
import torch
a = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.]); b = torch.tensor([3., 2., 1.])
print((a+b).tolist(), (a*b).tolist(), a.mean().item(), (a < b).tolist())
